steps: Combine Rolled oats, Cinnamon, Mashed banana, 1 Egg, Coconut milk, and Vanilla extract in a large bowl.
Fold Blueberries gently into the batter; let the mixture rest for 5 minutes so the oats absorb the liquid.
Heat Canola oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, about 160 °C (325 °F).
Drop heaped tablespoons of batter into the skillet, forming 12 small round patties.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes on the first side, until the edges look set and the bottoms are golden.
Flip each patty carefully and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more, until cooked through with no raw centre.
Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel; cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Makes 12 patties. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
